arxiv-1909-11184.title: Fuzzy Generalizations Of Automorphism and Inner Automorphism of Groups
arxiv-1909-11184.description: Abstract . The fuzzification of various concepts from classical set theory came into existence with the discovery of fuzzy set as a generalization of crisp set. This paper coins the terms like fuzzy permutations on a set, fuzzy endomorphism, fuzzy automorphism and fuzzy inner automorphisms of groups.

arxiv-2001-08375.title: Inverses, disintegrations, and Bayesian inversion in quantum Markov categories
arxiv-2001-08375.creator: Arthur J. Parzygnat
arxiv-2001-08375.description: Abstract We introduce quantum Markov categories as a structure that refines and extends a synthetic approach to probability theory and information theory so that it includes quantum probability and quantum information theory. In this broader context, we analyze three successively more general notions of reversibility and statistical inference: ordinary inverses, disintegrations, and Bayesian inverses.

arxiv-2011-07254.title: From spectral cluster to uniform resolvent estimates on compact manifolds
arxiv-2011-07254.creator: Jean-Claude Cuenin
arxiv-2011-07254.description: Abstract . It is well known that uniform resolvent estimates imply spectral cluster estimates. We show that the converse is also true in some cases. In particular, Sogge’s universal spectral cluster estimates for the Laplace–Beltrami operator on closed Riemannian manifolds directly imply uniform resolvent estimates outside a parabolic region, without any reference to parametrices.

arxiv-2111-13647.title: Emergent Pauli blocking in a weakly interacting Bose gas
arxiv-2111-13647.creator: Federica Cataldini, Frederik Møller, Mohammadamin Tajik, João Sabino, Si-Cong Ji, Igor Mazets, Thomas Schweigler, Bernhard Rauer, Jörg Schmiedmayer
arxiv-2111-13647.description: Abstract The relationship between many-body interactions and dimensionality is integral to numerous emergent quantum phenomena. A striking example is the Bose gas, which upon confinement to one dimension (1D) obeys an infinite set of conservation laws, prohibiting thermalization and constraining dynamics.

arxiv-2202-07490.title: The Blazar sequence and its Physical Understanding
arxiv-2202-07490.creator: Elisa Prandini, Gabriele Ghisellini
arxiv-2202-07490.description: Abstract Introduced in 1998 to attempt a first unified view of the broad-band emission properties of blazars, the blazar sequence has been extensively used in the past 25 years to guide observations as well as physical interpretation of the overall emission from these galaxies.

arxiv-2208-03166.title: Dust Temperature Profiles in Dense Cores Associated With Massive Star-Forming Regions
arxiv-2208-03166.creator: L. E. Pirogov
arxiv-2208-03166.description: Abstract Using the APEX-12m telescope, continuum maps at a wavelength of 350 \mu m of eight gas-dust clouds from the southern hemisphere are obtained. The clouds are associated with the regions of massive star and star cluster formation and have dense cores. The core sizes estimated at half of the maximum intensity level are \sim 0.1-0.2 pc.

arxiv-2211-08363.title: Emergence of Classicality in Stern-Gerlach Experiment via Self-Gravity
arxiv-2211-08363.creator: Sourav Kesharee Sahoo, Radhika Vathsan, Tabish Qureshi
arxiv-2211-08363.description: Abstract Emergence of classicality from quantum mechanics, a hotly debated topic, has had no satisfactory resolution so far. Various approaches including decoherence and gravitational interactions have been suggested. In the present work, the Schrödinger-Newton model is used to study the role of semi-classical self-gravity in the evolution of massive spin-1/2 particles in a Stern-Gerlach experiment.

arxiv-2504-06074.title: On Contact Round Surgeries on ( 𝕊 3 , ξ s ​ t ) (\mathbb{S}^{3},\xi_{st}) and their Diagrams
arxiv-2504-06074.creator: Prerak Deep, Dheeraj Kulkarni
arxiv-2504-06074.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Prerak Deep, Dheeraj Kulkarni. We introduce the notion of contact round surgery of index 1 1 on Legendrian knots in a general contact 3-manifold. It generalizes the notion of contact round surgery of index 1 on Legendrian knots introduced by Adachi.

arxiv-2511-17067.title: Exceptional line and pseudospectrum in black hole spectroscopy
arxiv-2511-17067.creator: Li-Ming Cao, Ming-Fei Ji, Liang-Bi Wu, Yu-Sen Zhou
arxiv-2511-17067.description: Abstract We investigate the exceptional points (EPs) and their pseudospectra in black hole perturbation theory. By considering a Gaussian bump modification to the Regge-Wheeler potential with variable amplitude, position, and width parameters, ( ε , d , σ 0 ) (\varepsilon,d,\sigma_{0}) , a continuous line of EPs (exceptional line, EL) in this three-dimensional parameter space is revealed.

arxiv-2602-02941.title: Effect of magnetic field on whirling-anti-whirling order in icosahedral-quasicrystal approximant
arxiv-2602-02941.creator: Shinji Watanabe, Tatsuya Iwasaki
arxiv-2602-02941.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Shinji Watanabe, Tatsuya Iwasaki. Recent neutron measurement in the icosahedral quasicrystal approximant Au-SM-Tb (SM=Al, Ga) has revealed unique noncollinear magnetic order “whirling-anti-whirling states”. Here, we report theoretical analysis on the magnetic-field-direction dependence on the whirling-anti-whirling order in the 1/1 approximant crystal. By performing exact-diagonalization calculation for the effective model taking into account the uniaxial magnetic anisotropy arising from the crystalline electric field, we show the metamagnetic transition takes place simultaneously with the topological transition under the magnetic field along the (111) direction.

openalex-w7204486540.title: Terapias biológicas na rinossinusite crônica grave com pólipos nasais: Eficácia, segurança e impacto sobre a necessidade de cirurgia e corticosteroides sistêmicos
openalex-w7204486540.creator: Maria Clara Peres de Castelo Branco, Jordana Magda da Silva Castro, MARIA VITORIA LINO MACHADO, Eduarda Moura dos Santos, Alana Granda Mendonça, Júlia Pires Silva, Maria Flávia Rigonato Lima
openalex-w7204486540.description: A rinossinusite crônica grave com pólipos nasais (RSCcPN) apresenta elevada carga sintomática, recorrência frequente e, em parte dos pacientes, necessidade repetida de corticosteroides sistêmicos e procedimentos cirúrgicos. Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar as evidências...

pmc-11975710.title: Demonstration of High Diagnostic Accuracy for Cerebral Ischemia in a Large Academic Hub-and -Spoke Telestroke Network
pmc-11975710.creator: Nikita Chhabra, Stephen W English, Monet Miller, Abigail E Hanus, Rida Basharath, Richard J Butterfield, Nan Zhang, Bart M Demaerschalk
pmc-11975710.description: ObjectiveTo determine the diagnostic accuracy of the initial telestroke consultation in a large academic hub-and-spoke telemedicine network.Patients and MethodsThis retrospective study includes all patients evaluated for cerebral ischemia through video telestroke consultation in a large academic hub-and-spoke telemedicine network from January 1, 2019 to December 31, 2020.

pmc-13081222.title: Bioprinting of Nanocellulose Hydrogels for Photobiocatalysis Under Continuous Flow
pmc-13081222.creator: Lenny Malihan-Yap, Lisa Schmedler, Daniel Pint, Hitesh Medipally, Florian Lackner, Simon Fedrigotti, Rupert Kargl, Karin Stana Kleinschek, Robert Kourist, Heidrun Gruber-Woelfler
pmc-13081222.description: Photosynthetic microorganisms are capable of oxygenic photosynthesis, delivering both oxygen and cofactors to drive enzymatic redox reactions. However, their dependence on visible light limits the tolerable cell densities to achieve high reaction rates. Immobilizing cells within a matrix often increases biocatalyst productivity while allowing facile retainment but also creates mass transfer limitations across the solid–liquid interface.

pmc-13255618.title: Composting Dynamics, Bedding Properties, and Seasonal Effects in Composting and Non-Composting Bedded-Pack Barns in a Subtropical Region
pmc-13255618.creator: Beatriz Danieli, Maksuel Gatto de Vitt, Fábio José Gomes Bertipaglia, Juliano Vitória Domingues, Aline Zampar, Maria Luísa Appendino Nunes Zotti, Patrícia Ferreira Ponciano Ferraz, Ana Luiza Bachmann Schogor
pmc-13255618.description: Simple SummaryThis study evaluated how barn design and seasonal conditions influence bedding dynamics in bedded-pack dairy systems with contrasting composting functionality. Nine farms were classified into three barn types: CONV (large conventional compost bedded-pack barns), ADAP (adapted compost bedded-pack barns), and PART (partially used bedded-pack barns without active composting management).

pmc-13323146.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and perceived barriers to seeking treatment for tuberculosis and diabetes in Ghana: a survey on world tuberculosis day
pmc-13323146.creator: Adwoa Asante-Poku, Michelle Yeboah-Manu, Stephen Osei-Wusu, Prince Asare, Augustine Asare Boadu, Emelia Konadu Danso, Phillip Tetteh, Ishaque Mintah Siam, Kenneth Mawuta Hayibor, Theophilus Afum, Emmanuel Afreh, Edmond Kwaku Ocloo, Isaac Darko Otchere, Nelly Arthur, Yaw Adusi-Poku, Charlotte-Alberta Cato, Abraham Adjei, Jane Afriyie-Mensah, Dorothy Yeboah-Manu

pmc-13417908.title: The Effect of 1-Ethyl-3-Methylimidazolium Chloride on Oxidative Stress and the Functioning of the Photosynthetic Apparatus in Maize Seedlings—The Modulatory Role of Exogenous Ascorbic Acid
pmc-13417908.creator: Barbara Pawłowska, Aleksandra Lechowska, Radomír Ščurek, Robert Biczak
pmc-13417908.description: Ionic liquids (ILs) are widely used chemical compounds that may pose potential risks to the environment. In the present study, the effects of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride (EMIMCl) on growth, photosynthetic performance, and oxidative stress in maize (Zea mays L.) seedlings were evaluated, and the role of exogenous L-ascorbic acid (AsA) in modulating plant responses to this stress was investigated.

pmc-13613577.title: Comparison of apical transportation and centering ratio between Bassi Logic and Protaper-Next NiTi rotary systems in curved canal by cone beam computed tomography: an in vitro study
pmc-13613577.creator: Maryam Khalili, Abbas Shokri, Hamed Karkehabadi, Fatemeh Ahanj, Amir-Masood Pour Mohammad, Mohammad Reza Moayedi
pmc-13613577.description: BackgroundPreservation of the original root canal anatomy is essential for the long-term success of endodontic treatment. Effective cleaning and shaping of the root canal system are critical steps in this process; however, canal transportation is a common procedural error during the preparation of curved canals.

pmc-13617692.title: Physics-guided framework for climate dependent disease prediction: coupling compartment model with deep learning
pmc-13617692.creator: Tengbiao Li, Weide Li, Shujuan Hu
pmc-13617692.description: BackgroundInfluenza-like illness (ILI) serves as a representative climate dependent disease due to its climate sensitivity, widespread transmission, and significant impact on public health and societal functioning, highlighting the urgent need for reliable ILI prediction techniques that combine climate factors to support effective prevention and intervention.
